_note: Salvaged actuator models for scrap/calc/scrap_select.py. Brushed DC: Ke = Kt (SI), R incl. brushes and wiring. Values marked status E are engineering estimates until measured on the lever-and-scale test (scrap guide step 3). Sources: docs/research/R11-scrap-build-parts.md.

drill18.label: salvaged 18 V cordless-drill motor (550 class) + its 2-stage planetary, low gear (about 400 rpm)
drill18.status: E (motor constants from the class datasheets; measure your drill on the lever test)
drill18.source: R11: Ozito PXDDS-180 0-400 rpm / 40 N·m; Mabuchi RS-775WC 18 V 19,500 rpm, 1.215 N·m at 130 A; RS-550VC 0.588 N·m at 85 A (14.4 V); BTS7960 43 A trip, 15-20 A continuous

hub36.label: hoverboard 6.5 in hub motor, tyre removed (36 V, FOC on the hoverboard mainboard)
hub36.status: E (I_max 25 A and I_cont are estimates; measure)
hub36.source: R11: Kt 0.45 (MIT XRL) to 0.52 N·m/A (ODrive 8.27/Kv), R 0.18-0.28 ohm, 22.5 N·m at 50 A unsaturated; firmware default 15 A per motor (raise to 25 A with heatsinking, estimate); 2.2 kg with tyre

servo20.label: 20 kg·cm hobby servo (DS3218 class, metal gears), 6.8 V
servo20.source: [estimate] DS3218 class: 20 kg·cm (1.96 N·m) stall at 6.8 V, 0.14-0.16 s/60 deg; not in R11 - check the listing

hubfoc.label: hoverboard 6.5 in hub motor, tyre removed, on a 48 V bus with an ODESC V4.2 FOC drive (quasi-direct drive)
hubfoc.driver: ODESC V4.2 single (8-56 V, 70 A cont. claimed, ODrive firmware)
hubfoc.source: R11: Kt 0.45-0.52 N·m/A, R 0.18-0.28 ohm, 22.5 N·m at 50 A unsaturated (MIT XRL), 2.2 kg with tyre; ODESC V4.2 US$27-39 (reach.dog, sequremall) to US$74 (Fruugo), 8-56 V, 70 A continuous / 120 A peak (seller claims); I_max 50 A = the MIT XRL measured point (22.5 N·m, no saturation); I_cont 14 A is an estimate - measure
